items.briefing:
Australian organisations are rapidly adopting AI tools, but governance isn't keeping pace. A report highlights that Australian executives continue to trust AI outputs despite known audit errors, raising concerns about decisions being made on unreliable data. Separately, research warns that poorly managed AI deployments can introduce both technical and compliance risks that are difficult to detect until something goes wrong.

On the scam front, Scamwatch continues to flag active threats targeting Australians. If you receive unexpected messages asking you to verify accounts or click links, treat them with suspicion regardless of how legitimate they appear.

**Tip:** Before acting on any AI-generated report or summary at work, apply a quick sense-check — don't assume the output is accurate without verifying key figures against the source.

featured.title: Australian enterprises are scaling agents faster than governance - MCP is the fix
featured.summary: Governance gaps are slowing enterprise AI adoption, with 79% of Australian DevSecOps professionals saying compliance is getting harder.
